statement: Correction to the preceding visual shorthand: immutable Run 099-simulate confirms all three customer paths are two cells and all 88 devices are delivered with 12/12 lots on time, but full-run telemetry does not show zero blockage on every terminal lane. commercial-to-customer records 600 blocked item-ticks (300 endpoint-capacity and 300 endpoint-power), performance-to-customer records 99,801 (65,101 line-contention, 6,200 endpoint-capacity, and 28,500 endpoint-power), and automotive-to-customer is absent from the positive-blocking contributors. The compact layout remains a strict five-case KEEP because service, constraints, capacity, and every current-factory score guard pass; the event-phase transport and shipping-power ripple is retained as separate operating evidence for later design.
